name: Phanturn
look: a ghostly blue deep-sea angler with a golden cross-marked cap, a red eye, a fanged mouth caged by golden bars, spotted head fins, a swept tail fin and golden threads dangling glowing pearls and a little ghost-fish lure
entry: It drifts up out of the deep at night, trailing glowing pearls. Lost sailors follow the light of its little golden lure, thinking it is a lantern on the shore, and are never seen again.
how: Use a Reaper Cloth on a Lanturn. It learns Hex when it evolves.
